activity_summary: Still in the hall, you said you had spoken the prologue between the degrees, and that indoors every hour is night. Pope's Nurse had done what my lord said a nurse would do, and he would not repeat the sentence. Nick had stayed grave and low, held to the dagger, under every note, and Burbage had not looked away. The end was a rustle, one cough, and the chair rising, not the Theatre's hush. A gold button set with five pearls was gone from the kirtle since the play began. Sam had searched the stage-front and under the trestles for half an hour and had not found it. Nothing had glinted. Kemp said, aside, that a little gold thing may raise a bigger search than a missing player ever did. Heminges told him to keep it until the inn, down the river, and not to tell it at the Feathers. You did not find the button. You were still in the hall.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Reported the prologue and the indoor night, and refused a second search.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Said the aside, and agreed to hold it until the inn.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Stopped the story at the Feathers and kept five pearls out of the book.

entities.name: Sam Latchet
entities.context: Searched half an hour and reported rushes, not a find.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Kept the not-looking as a fact of the night, and took Sam off the floor.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Kept the held note from becoming a song.

entities.name: Thomas Pope
entities.context: Reported the Nurse without repeating my lord's sentence.

entities.name: Queen Elizabeth
entities.context: Not in the talk. The kirtle and the chair were told.

entities.name: Henry Carey, 1st Lord Hunsdon
entities.context: Not in the talk. His old sentence about a nurse was not repeated.

facets.activity: Held Kemp's aside until the inn

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Indoors, every hour is night. The vault did not need a dusk, and I did not give it one.

quotes.speaker: richard_burbage
quotes.text: I did not look away. He held to the dagger.

quotes.speaker: sam_latchet
quotes.text: Half an hour. The length of the stage-front, and under the trestles.

quotes.speaker: will_kemp
quotes.text: A little gold thing may raise a bigger search than a missing player ever did.

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
